# Heatpress DTF Transfer Sheets

The live app: lay out DTF transfer sheets and download print-ready 300 DPI
files. Everything runs in the browser — logos are never uploaded anywhere.

**This repository is generated output.** Do not edit these files by hand; they
are built from the source project by `tools/build_static.py` and any manual
change will be overwritten by the next publish.

Served by GitHub Pages from the repository root.
